INSTRUCTION target identifies entry, not parent, so family undefined. The family&& guard skips enabledFamilies. Receipt-first at116 and exact command/queue binding at90-105 precede this; preserve them.

Accepted-edit helper and queue selectors currently require ITEM target, then isManualItem(tripId,command.target.id,family). They are closed to Instructions. Only opening ITEM selector would expose the Worker family skip without a parent resolver.

Existing isManualItem resolver and guarded submit accept a parent ITEM ID. acceptedEditableItem uses exact accepted certificate/account/actor/trip/family/owner/lifecycle/coreCanManage. Current guarded submit uses command.target.id as parent and ITEM base match. This is an additional direct consumer of the same parent-identity resolution, not a separate new permission system.

minimalNativeOwningHookup.correct: Use Root1 verified current entry+immutable chain+actor/Trip/parent binding to resolve true parent, not target.id interpreted as ITEM; preserve existing correction eligibility proof. Missing/ambiguous/mismatched/stale parent or entry fails closed.

minimalNativeOwningHookup.selectors: Only after formal owning envelope is available, narrowly recognize typed INSTRUCTION candidates, resolve parent for existing isManualItem/acceptedEditableItem, preserve target entry queue identity and exact original operation. No global acceptedEdit family opening or default-enabled Hosted profile.
